criteria.traceability: Exactly89 originalmanifest indices once; sourcegeometry byte hashes unchanged; rigid transforms and identical intended nominal dimensions.
criteria.adhesion: Each part expected model first-layer region vs exact mesh, including broad contact and islands. Support/brim cannot replace required model contact. Whole native footprint>=4mm separation and positive bed/exclusionclearance.
criteria.surface: Each annotated screw seat, motor mating plane and sliding surface either moved out of downward support exposure or validated by region-specific native interface/skin analysis; no generic nonzero firstlayer acceptance.
criteria.bridges: Measure actual model bridge XY spans, path speeds and orientation; intentional hole bridges distinguished from model exterior unsupported spans. Horizontal screw/pocket holes require native crosssection checks.
criteria.support_access: Each part support removal access remains available; no inaccessible packed support inside motor/bearing/connector cavities. Clearance/screw-hole sizes not widened or cut to mask printing.
criteria.physical_boundary: Digital extrusion never establishes physical bore roundness, seat flatness, adhesion or support removability. Actual print fit tests remain separate.
